instruction: Write an XDP program that must profile endpoint session timing using nanosecond timestamps in 'flow_time_05'. Store first_seen and last_seen timestamps. Return XDP_PASS for all traffic.
requirements: Define struct flow_timing containing __u64 first_seen and __u64 last_seen
Define BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH map 'flow_time_05' with key __u32 and value struct flow_timing
Verify Ethernet and IPv4 header bounds against data_end
Query bpf_ktime_get_ns() and record first_seen and last_seen timestamps for ip->saddr
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration
